summary: Zenas BioPharma filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) on November 6, 2026, disclosing a new at-the-market prospectus supplement under its existing Sales Agreement with Jefferies LLC, covering up to $200 million of common stock. Roughly $153.2 million of shares had been sold under the prior October 8, 2025 supplement, leaving about $46.8 million unsold; that prior program is terminated. Ropes & Gray provided the legal opinion and consent. This is a routine shelf/ATM takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any selling pressure.
